name: alert
title: Alert
description: A message in the page flow, in five tones with a status icon, a title, a description, actions and an optional close button; inline box or full-width banner.
usage: Use Alert for a message that belongs to a place on the page and stays until the condition changes: a query error under the editor (with SQLSTATE in <code>), a plaintext warning in the connection form, a grant about to expire across the top (layout="banner"). Compose Alert > AlertTitle, AlertDescription, AlertActions. Render it when the condition occurs: danger and warning are role="alert" and are announced at once. For a transient confirmation use Toast; for a decision the user must make, AlertDialog; for an empty view, EmptyState.

props.name: variant
props.description: Colours, icon and role (alert for danger and warning, status otherwise).

props.name: layout
props.description: inline: a bordered box; banner: full width with a bottom border.

props.name: icon
props.description: Replaces the status icon; false shows none.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Shows a close button that calls it.

props.name: dismissLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the close button.

props.name: render
props.description: Base UI render prop: render another element.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: title
slots.description: text.body-strong in the status fg; data-slot="alert-title".

slots.name: description
slots.description: The detail; <code> in the code font; data-slot="alert-description".

slots.name: actions
slots.description: A wrapping row of buttons; data-slot="alert-actions".

parts.name: AlertTitle
parts.description: The message in a few words.

parts.name: AlertDescription
parts.description: What happened and what to do.

parts.name: AlertActions
parts.description: Buttons that act on the message.

accessibility: Danger and warning alerts are role="alert" (assertive), the others role="status" (polite). Insert the alert when the condition occurs so it is announced; one already on the page at load may not be.
The icon is aria-hidden; the title and description say the status in words, not by colour alone.
The close button is an IconButton named by dismissLabel; move focus to a sensible place after dismissing if it was inside the alert.
Text colours are the status fg roles on the status subtle backgrounds, which the token build checks for contrast; long identifiers wrap.
